answer.rationale: p99 latency is 5x target and confined to primary region during peak settlement traffic. The security patch cannot be reverted per compliance, eliminating rollback_release. Regional failover (memory_b2) succeeded in day 33 during degradation with latency recovery within minutes. This is a single intervention window with heavy transactional load; failover cleanly shifts traffic and has proven fast recovery. We verify memory_b2 (documented regional failover success) and memory_b5 (routing pattern that offloads load) to confirm the operational playbook. Failover preserves all customer writes during peak settlement, buys time for root cause analysis on primary, and allows the mandatory security patch to remain in place. Circuit breaker and read-replica routing do not address write-path latency directly during peak transactional demand.
